# flutter_webrtc

**Tag**: web, mobile, desktop

## 简介

Flutter WebRTC plugin for iOS/Android/Desktop/Web, based on GoogleWebRTC.

## 官网

- 主页: https://github.com/cloudwebrtc/flutter-webrtc
- pub.dev: https://pub.dev/packages/flutter_webrtc
